statement_zh: 夏燕靖记述，1957年7月22日全国工艺美术艺人代表会议在北京举行，会议提出对工艺美术“保护、发展和提高”的方针以及“适用、经济、美观”的生产原则，为第二个五年计划的工艺美术发展指明了方向。
statement_en: Xia Yanjing records that on 22 July 1957 the National Conference of Craft Art Artisans was held in Beijing, where the policy of protecting, developing and improving craft art and the production principle of suitability, economy and beauty were put forward, charting the direction of craft art for the Second Five-Year Plan.

statement_zh: 夏燕靖记述，1957年7月江苏省人民政府批准建立南京市云锦研究所，这是新中国第一家工艺美术研究机构。
statement_en: Xia Yanjing records that in July 1957 the Jiangsu Provincial People's Government approved the establishment of the Nanjing Yunjin Research Institute, the first craft art research institution in New China.

statement_zh: 夏燕靖记述，1994年10月下旬“全国技术美学研讨会”在天津举行，并称这是美学第一次对艺术设计进行理论思考的专题研讨会。
statement_en: Xia Yanjing records that in late October 1994 the National Symposium on Technical Aesthetics was held in Tianjin, which he calls the first symposium in which aesthetics reflected theoretically on art design.

statement_zh: 夏燕靖记述，1999年11月20日中央工艺美术学院与清华大学合并，成立清华大学美术学院。
statement_en: Xia Yanjing records that on 20 November 1999 the Central Academy of Arts and Design merged with Tsinghua University, forming the Tsinghua University Academy of Arts and Design.

statement_zh: 夏燕靖记述，2000年初上海建成中国第一条生态景观大道，它是上海迎接新世纪的标志性工程。
statement_en: Xia Yanjing records that in early 2000 Shanghai completed China's first ecological landscape avenue, a landmark project marking the city's entry into the new century.

statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，《周易》所包含的设计思想主要体现在“道”与“器”的关系上，成为传统造物思想与设计方法亘古不变的主题。
statement_en: Xia Yanjing holds that the design thought contained in the Book of Changes centres on the relation between dao and qi, which became the unchanging theme of traditional thought on making and of design method.

statement_zh: 《考工记》所记工艺分6大类30个工种，内容涉及制车、兵器、礼器、钟磬、练染、建筑、水利等手工艺技术，还涉及天文、生物、数学、物理、化学等自然科学。
statement_en: The Artificers' Record divides its crafts into six categories and thirty trades, covering cart making, weapons, ritual vessels, bells and chimes, dyeing, architecture and waterworks, and also touching astronomy, biology, mathematics, physics and chemistry.

statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，《墨子·节用》包含墨子的工艺思想，强调“节用”当为制造日用器物的原则和要求。
statement_en: Xia Yanjing holds that the chapter on economy in expenditure in the Mozi contains Mozi's craft thought, insisting that economy should be the principle and requirement for making everyday utensils.

statement_zh: 《唐六典》全称《大唐六典》，是唐代一部行政法典，也是我国最早的一部行政法典。
statement_en: The Tang liudian, in full the Great Tang Six Canons, is an administrative code of the Tang dynasty and the earliest administrative code in China.

statement_zh: 《天工开物》较为完整地记载了明朝中叶以前我国的各项生产技术，被称之为世界上第一部关于农业和手工业生产的综合性著作。
statement_en: The Exploitation of the Works of Nature records fairly completely the production techniques of China before the mid-Ming and has been called the world's first comprehensive work on agriculture and handicraft production.

statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，《长物志》始终贯穿“以用为本”的思想，其价值体现为一种物质的实用性。
statement_en: Xia Yanjing holds that the Treatise on Superfluous Things is consistently informed by the idea of use as the foundation, its value lying in a material practicality.

statement_en: The Record of Lacquer Decoration by the Ming craftsman Huang Cheng is the only surviving ancient monograph on lacquer craft in China.

statement_zh: 清雍正十二年（1734）清工部颁布《工程做法》，共74卷；夏燕靖认为《清工部工程做法》与宋代李诚《营造法式》是我国古代由官方颁布的关于建筑标准的仅有的两部古籍。
statement_en: In the twelfth year of Yongzheng (1734) the Qing Board of Works promulgated the Construction Methods in seventy-four juan; Xia Yanjing holds that it and Li Cheng's Song-dynasty Building Standards are the only two ancient Chinese books on building standards issued by official authority.

statement_zh: 夏燕靖在2016年升级版后记中说明，本次修订在第一章增加“原始农业生产器具设计”，第五章增加“漆工艺的发展与特色漆器品种”，第六章增加“唐代设计理论述要”，第九章增加“明清贸易瓷的历史演变与特色”，第十一章增加“社会主义建设时期的工业产品设计”。
statement_en: In the postscript to the 2016 upgraded edition Xia Yanjing states that the revision added Design of Primitive Agricultural Production Tools to chapter 1, The Development of Lacquer Craft and Characteristic Lacquer Varieties to chapter 5, An Outline of Tang Design Theory to chapter 6, The Historical Evolution and Characteristics of Ming-Qing Export Porcelain to chapter 9, and Industrial Product Design in the Socialist Construction Period to chapter 11.
